items.title: Humana (HUM) Declares Dividend, Is The Stock Still Cheap?
items.summary: Humana dividend announcement and why it matters now Humana (HUM) just confirmed a cash dividend of $0.885 per share, payable on January 29, 2027, to shareholders on record as of December 24, 2026. For income focused investors, that fixed cash payout gives a concrete figure to plug into yield calculations, especially with Humana’s recent share price at $417.87. items.title: Is Humana (HUM) Getting Too Expensive For Its Earnings?
items.summary: Humana has delivered a sharp upswing this year, and the share price now bakes a lot more expectation into the story. The key issue for you is whether that higher tag still lines up with what the insurer is actually earning. The stock is up 55.2% year to date, which puts real weight on the question of how much of Humana's earnings power is already reflected in the current price. items.title: Elizabeth Warren Wants to Break Up UnitedHealth, and One Day Later a Nonprofit Called It Undervalued
items.summary: Elizabeth Warren is pushing to dismantle UnitedHealth Group just as a nonprofit investor education group moves in the opposite direction, naming the embattled insurer its top undervalued pick for early 2027. The timing raises a question every UNH shareholder needs to answer.
